mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines while housing starts (HOUST) rise, it indicates a supply-demand mismatch where production cannot meet demand, causing inventory shortages and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite INDPRO fall and HOUST rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During an inflationary cycle (CPIAUCSL > 3% annualized), the Federal Reserve's aggressive rate hikes compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL > 3%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the prior 3 months signals expanding economic activity that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in GDP growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly growth rate of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5%, it indicates robust labor market conditions that increase consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) declines while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls, it signals coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus that accelerates economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE fall, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime, a monthly decline in retail sales (RSAFS growth rate < -0.3%) signals weakening consumer demand that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite RSAFS growth < -0.3%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
